label: common_2020_mizu_020_mizu_01
text: Ever since ya fought for that choice seaweed for\nme, all my dishes usin’ it have been big hits![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_020_mizu_02
text: Thanks for that! Guess it’s no surprise you did so\nwell—what with bein’ worthy of Champion Rank![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_020_mizu_03
text: Goodness gracious, but do I ever meet all kinds\nof people while doin’ this job.[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_020_mizu_04
text: I’ve seen people like yerself who run full speed\nahead like a ragin’ river, and plenty o’ people\r\nwho settle down like a calm lake.[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_020_mizu_05
text: We older folk tend to prefer the latter, o’ course,\nbut this ol’ man himself finds that a bit dull.[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_020_mizu_06
text: Rivers flow into the ocean. That water then climbs\nup into the clouds an’ becomes rain.[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_020_mizu_07
text: I am Kofu the Torrent! Ever changin’—just like\nwater! Now come see what I’m made of![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_020_mizu_08
text: You really put the pressure on! Guess I should’ve\nexpected no less from someone with La Primera’s\r\nseal of approval! What a catch![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_020_mizu_09
text: The wildest currents—for better or worse—pull in\neverythin’ around ’em and have really wild and\r\ndrastic effects on their surroundin’s![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_020_mizu_10
text: That makes those friends o’ yours who stay by\nyour side all the more important.[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_020_mizu_11
text: Phew! Your youthful vigor’s got my motivation\nflowin’ up like a rising tide![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_020_mizu_12
text: Next time you see Ms. Geeta, tell ’er that ol’\nman Kofu’s flowin’ and crashin’ more than ever![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: common_2020_mizu_020_mizu_13
text: Don’t forget to tell ’er, young friend! And you\ncome back to see me again, now, ya hear?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
